purpose: Teach: 心底/まんが/諸々/愛想/すばやく/はまり/ゆで/まだしも

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんに会えて心底嬉しかったわね
lines.en: Sho, seeing Grandpa today made you so happy, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost to herself. Soft voice, gentle smile in the tone. Not a question seeking answer — an observation of something she saw. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、まんがを読むのが大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love reading manga.
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager to share. Small voice but clear conviction. No self-consciousness — just stating something true. Energy that wants her to hear it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが諸々のお手伝いをして下さるわ
lines.en: Your father's taking care of everything for us, sweetheart.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance, almost matter-of-fact. Quiet gratitude underneath. Practical tone with a thread of relief — one less thing to worry about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに愛想良く挨拶したよ
lines.en: That's wonderful, Sho — you greeted Grandpa so nicely.
lines.style: Immediate, warm approval. Recognition landing softly. Not over-praising, just acknowledging. Voice settles into a smile.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはすばやく支度をされたわ
lines.en: Your father got ready very quickly — he was so efficient.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, slightly distracted. Noticing something that moved her. Quiet respect in the phrasing. Not delivered to Sho as much as half-said aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きにすっかりはまりこんでるよ
lines.en: You're really into your drawing lately, aren't you?
lines.style: Playful noticing, warm amusement. Gentle teasing underneath — she's seen him absorbed in it. Light, knowing tone. Not interrogating, just delighted.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、夕飯にゆで卵を作りましょうね
lines.en: Let's make soft-boiled eggs for dinner, okay?
lines.style: Practical, calm instruction. Includes Sho gently — 'let's' not 'I will'. Warm and matter-of-fact. The comfort of routine in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、雨ならまだしも、雪まで降るとは思わなかったよ
lines.en: I didn't think it would actually snow — I thought maybe rain at worst.
lines.style: Quiet surprise, slight wonder. Introspective, almost to herself. Sho listening in on a small moment of her being caught off-guard. Gentle, observant tone.
